## MedplumClientOptions.logoutUrl property

OAuth2 logout URL.

Default value is `baseUrl + "/oauth2/logout"`<!-- -->.

Can be specified as absolute URL or relative to baseUrl.

Use this if you want to use a separate OAuth server.

**Signature:**

```typescript
logoutUrl?: string;
```
